summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed after print; joins str() of objects with sep, calls self.print once with end/style/highlight passed through and emoji=False, markup=False, no_wrap=True, overflow="ignore", crop=False; highlight defaults to True). Added CHANGELOG bullet "Added Console.out" under Unreleased/Added, a "Low level output" section in docs/source/console.rst after the logging section, and tests in tests/test_console.py (test_out plus test_out_no_objects, test_out_returns_none, test_out_markup, test_out_emoji, test_out_no_pretty_print, test_out_no_crop, test_out_style, test_out_highlight_default/none/false, test_out_render_hook) with RenderHook and Text imported at the top of the module. Tests were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing was committed.
